issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The new code adds a second XGBoost model on atom-pair and topological-torsion count fingerprints plus RDKit descriptors, and blends the three models by rank. It reads no files and uses no test labels; test SMILES are only turned into features.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. The rank blend is computed per fold on test predictions only. Weights are 0.25/0.25/0.5. The old blend weighted XGB and SVR equally, so the SVR keeps the same share and the old XGB part is split between the two XGB models.

Minor: the variable p_rf holds XGB predictions, not random forest ones. The name is misleading but does no harm. ap_features also builds the generators and computes all descriptors on every call, which is slower but correct.

Recomputed z from the shown numbers: (0.4718 - 0.477) / (0.0070 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1)) = -0.0052 / 0.0099 ≈ -0.525. The harness gives -0.523; the gap is rounding in the displayed values. The candidate is slightly worse and within noise, so reject is the right call. The added complexity is also not justified.
